value:
  modules:
    - id: p
      value:
        type: rawscript
        language: python3
        content: "def main(): return 1"
        input_transforms: {}
    - id: d
      value:
        type: rawscript
        language: deno
        content: "export async function main() { return 1 }"
        input_transforms: {}
    - id: g
      value:
        type: rawscript
        language: go
        content: "package inner"
        input_transforms: {}
    - id: b
      value:
        type: rawscript
        language: bash
        content: "echo 1"
        input_transforms: {}
    - id: q
      value:
        type: rawscript
        language: postgresql
        content: "select 1"
        input_transforms: {}

cases.title: a root script without a harness names the script
the Bun family runs in the Bun harness

files.f/x/main.flow/flow.yaml:
value:
  modules:
    - id: b
      value:
        type: rawscript
        language: bun
        content: "export async function main() { return 1 }"
        input_transforms: {}
    - id: n
      value:
        type: rawscript
        language: nativets
        content: "export async function main() { return 1 }"
        input_transforms: {}
    - id: f
      value: {type: script, path: f/x/q}

note: Each leaf's harness class (0002, Language and harness class). python3, deno, go and bash have classes that only the later harnesses of L1 provide; other languages have none.
